title: Michelson-Morley ether experiments

tellings.quote: you have the Michaelson Morley experiments of the 1890s where you know they did a set of these sort of optical detections

plain: In the 1890s, by Michels' dating, the scientists Michelson and Morley ran a set of light experiments to detect the ether, an invisible medium once thought to carry light through space. Michels tells this himself while talking with the biologist Rupert Sheldrake, as an example of an experiment that shook up established science.
